acceptance.given: Before formal RED, the plan, Acceptance, declared tests, helpers, fixtures, and selectors are enumerated with immutable execution-snapshot inputs and a declared production-owner allowlist.

oracle.expected: A freeze manifest or equivalent contract check records all listed test/plan inputs as unchanged through RED and implementation, verifies every production edit path is in the declared owner allowlist, and verifies no production owner path is included among immutable execution-snapshot inputs.
forbidden: Any listed test, helper, fixture, selector, Acceptance, or plan input changes after freeze during implementation.
An implementation edit targets a production path outside the declared production-owner allowlist.
A production owner path is used as an immutable execution-snapshot input.
oracle.observable: The freeze/ownership validation artifact compares pre-RED and post-implementation hashes and changed-path sets, reports only declared production owners as writable implementation paths, and reports disjoint owner versus snapshot path sets.

acceptance.then: The freeze and ownership checks produce a passing boundary artifact only when all frozen inputs remain unchanged, implementation changes are confined to declared production owners, and owner paths are disjoint from immutable execution snapshots.
acceptance.when: During pre-RED freeze validation and again after implementation, inspect the declared freeze manifest, immutable snapshot hashes, implementation changed-path set, and owner/snapshot path intersection.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A freeze-validation selector mutates a declared test, helper, fixture, selector, Acceptance, or plan input after the freeze point and must fail the hash or immutability check.
An ownership-boundary selector records an implementation edit to a production path outside the declared production-owner allowlist and must fail path authorization.
A boundary selector declares the same repository-relative path as both a production owner and an immutable execution snapshot and must fail the disjointness check.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or enforce a deterministic freeze manifest and ownership-boundary check that protects declared execution snapshots and rejects undeclared implementation writes or owner/snapshot path overlap.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback removes only the Package A validator, policy, schemas, and documentation additions; preserve existing scripts/sc protocols and all frozen test/fixture inputs.

slice_hint.state_transition: state_before: formal RED and implementation have not begun; state_after: execution inputs are frozen, ownership is declared, and implementation changes are bounded to that owner set.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The freeze/ownership validator passes with unchanged snapshot hashes, changed paths wholly contained in declared production owners, and an empty owner-versus-snapshot intersection.
